answer: Each agent identity is a voyage through recursively composed zero-knowledge reputation commitments whose transcript binds a sequential-delay pearl of accumulated work, so any clone must replay the full sequential transcript within the same epoch; a whisper of prior state suffices defeasibly, but absent unconditional verification in the common reference string, identity cloning reduces to forging VRF sortition proofs under adaptive corruptions and is bounded only by simulation-extractable commitments, making spoofing hardness conditional rather than information-theoretic.
